description: Kareen Lomax makes music for those on the journey towards self-love without a paddle to steer with. Having scored blockbuster hits alongside Diplo, as well as for the likes of Maroon 5, Syd, Leon Bridges, and more, her artist project, which contains blushes of neo-soul, progressive R&B, and acoustic ballads, sees her turning the spotlight onto herself. With a ferocious pen and heart-stopping voice, Lomax is full of hyper-relatable screeds and salves for anyone still struggling with loss.
